verdict.rationale: Aircall natively routes incoming calls automatically through IVR menus combined with business-hours scheduling. That is a configured rule that acts on a call event. Its AI Assistants also update CRM records and create follow-up tasks automatically after conversations. The webhook and smart-routing tutorials are developer building blocks and earn no credit here. Nothing shows a general user-defined 'when event X, do action Y' rule builder. missing for 10: general-purpose rule/workflow builder for arbitrary event→action automations, documented rule conditions and action catalog, coverage beyond call routing and AI post-call tasks, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Route incoming calls automatically using a keypad menu (IVR) so callers can reach the right team, combined with business-hours scheduling
AI Assistants capture notes, update CRM records, and create follow-up tasks automatically
